description: This Java source file defines a Spring component class 'TelemetryAndEventCli' which extends 'AmqpCliClient' to facilitate sending telemetry and event data via AMQP protocol to the Hono platform. It includes methods for initializing message sending during application startup, connecting to the message broker, sending messages, and handling delivery reports.

classes.name: TelemetryAndEventCli
classes.description: Spring component for sending telemetry and event messages via AMQP using Proton protocol. Extends 'AmqpCliClient' and is activated under 'amqp-send' profile. Handles message preparation, connection setup, message sending, and delivery reporting during application startup.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes message sending process upon component initialization, waits for message delivery, logs delivery status or errors, and exits the application.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Establishes an AMQP connection to the adapter, creates a sender, sends a message with specified address and payload, and completes the provided future with delivery info or exception.

methods.name: printDelivery
methods.description: Logs the delivery state information, including rejection details if applicable, to the console.
